segments.title: 第130章 床上美人
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 130: Beauty on the Bed

"Do you have anything else to do this afternoon?"

After buying the groceries, Yan Zhusheng watched Li Luo walk into the kitchen and couldn't help but ask from the doorway.

"This afternoon?" Li Luo put on an apron and thought for a moment. "I was thinking of buying a laptop."

"Don't you have a computer in your bedroom?"

"Well..." Li Luo smiled helplessly. "Lately, Xixi is always using the computer, which is kind of affecting my writing, so it's better if I buy one for myself."

"Is that so." Yan Zhusheng fell into a thoughtful state, then asked, "Besides the computer, is there anything else?"

"Not for now."

Yan Zhusheng nodded, went back to the sofa in the living room and sat down. Watching Li Luo's busy figure in the kitchen, she silently took out her phone and made a call.

Almost an hour later, Li Luo had simply made three dishes and called Yan Zhusheng over to the dining table to eat together.

But they had barely taken a few bites when a knock came from the door.

Before Li Luo, the master of the house, could get up, Yan Zhusheng had already shot to her feet and jogged to the door to open it.

"Who could it be at this hour?" Li Luo stood up with a puzzled expression and followed, only to see Yan Zhusheng open the door and take a shock-proof bag, similar to a briefcase, from the hands of an auntie.

After seeing the auntie off, Yan Zhusheng, carrying the bag, turned to face Li Luo, extended her hand, and passed the bag to him.

"What's this?"

"A gift for you."

"Huh?"

Li Luo reached out to take it, opened it, and glanced inside, then froze for a moment. "A laptop?"

"Mhm."

"This looks like an ASUS, right?" Li Luo pulled out the laptop, looked at it for a couple of seconds, then asked.

"I think so, I don't really remember." Yan Zhusheng looked a bit blank, clearly not knowing much about this.

Li Luo clicked his tongue, thinking that a flagship ASUS laptop like this would cost at least ten thousand yuan at this time.

"Wait... did you just have someone buy this, or where did you get it from?"

"This is my mom's," Yan Zhusheng said honestly.

"..." Li Luo's face was full of question marks. He quickly stuffed the computer back into the bag. "I can't possibly take this. Hurry and take it back. If your mom finds out, she'll kill me."

"It's okay." Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "My mom got a new laptop, so this one was left at home for me to use, but I usually just use it to listen to music. I don't really need it."

"That's still not right." Li Luo shook his head. "It's such a valuable item. How can you just give it away like that?"

"Then just consider it a loan." Yan Zhusheng blinked, finally showing a sliver of her true intention. "If you feel bad about it, you can let me read your draft stockpile."

"So that's what you were waiting for?"

"No." Yan Zhusheng wore a pure and innocent expression. "I was just saying. I don't really need to read it."

"You can read it if you want." Li Luo sighed. Someone was bringing him a pillow just when he was getting sleepy. It saved him the time of buying a new computer. All in all, it was a good thing.

As for the draft stockpile, he wasn't worried that Yan Zhusheng would get bored after reading it and go spoil things in the comment section.

"But let me make it clear beforehand," Li Luo said. "You can read the stockpile, but after you finish it, if you want to read new plot developments, you'll still have to wait just like everyone else. After all, this book of mine is still far from being truly finished."

"It's okay." Yan Zhusheng pursed her lips, as if already savoring the taste of the drafts. "I won't read too much."

"Heh, I hope so," Li Luo tutted, then a question suddenly occurred to him. "So who was it that just delivered the computer?"

"The cooking auntie."

"The cooking auntie offers that kind of service too?"

"You just have to pay per trip."

"O-Okay... I stand corrected for my ignorance."

Was this how the problem of the cooking auntie's employment was solved?

After accepting Yan Zhusheng's kind offer, Li Luo put the laptop back in his bedroom.

After lunch, Yan Zhusheng obediently started clearing the table and conscientiously went to the kitchen to wash the dishes.

Li Luo, on the other hand, returned to his bedroom. Taking advantage of the free time in the afternoon, he started writing.

He didn't know when it happened, but after he had finished two chapters, he turned his head to find that Yan Zhusheng had quietly sat down on the edge of his bed, watching him with a serene expression.

"You're so quiet, it's a little scary." The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched. He felt a bit bad letting her just sit there like that.

So he simply downloaded his stockpile of over two hundred thousand words as a text file, compressed it, and sent it to Yan Zhusheng's phone.

"If you're bored, just read this," Li Luo glanced at the time. "I'll write for a little longer, until four o'clock."

"Oh, okay." Yan Zhusheng nodded. Although her expression didn't give anything away, the act of pulling out her phone exposed her impatience.

After a while, Yan Zhusheng asked, "Can I lie down to read? My neck is a little tired from sitting."

Li Luo was in the middle of writing a climatic scene, his mind brimming with inspiration, so he just grunted in acknowledgment, not paying much attention to Yan Zhusheng.

When four o'clock arrived and Li Luo finished his work on time, he turned to look again. Yan Zhusheng was already lying on her stomach on his bed, occasionally kicking her little calves and feet, engrossed in reading on her phone.

At this moment, Yan Zhusheng was still wearing her school uniform.

But the blue and white jacket had been taken off at some unknown point and was casually placed on Li Luo's bed.

Yan Zhusheng was only wearing the short-sleeved school shirt with its white base and blue trim, along with the solid blue autumn school pants.

At first glance, only a pair of snow-white arms and a section of fair, tender ankles were exposed.

Even her slender neck was hidden by a cascade of black, waterfall-like hair that had been let down from a high ponytail.

But just this picturesque image of her, with hair flowing down to her waist, was enough to make one's heart feel refreshed and clear, like drinking from a sweet spring.

Especially when Yan Zhusheng kicked up one of her feet. The white sock covering it traced a graceful arc, and the cuff of her blue school pants slid down with the movement, revealing a section of snow-white, delicate calf skin.

It was as fair and delectable as a small pudding, far more tantalizing than a skirt that simply exposed the calf.

However... you're being a little too casual...

"Are you done writing?" Yan Zhusheng noticed Li Luo's gaze and turned to look at him.

"I'm done," Li Luo said. "Let's go to the piano room. We should leave."

"Oh, I'll use the restroom then." With that, Yan Zhusheng got off the bed, slipped on some slippers, and walked into Li Luo's bathroom.

Li Luo stood up, walked to the side of the bed, looked at his bedsheet, and for a moment, was lost in thought.

A few minutes later.

The two arrived at the piano room.

Yan Zhusheng sat at the piano, looked up at Li Luo, and asked, "Should we practice?"

"Let's skip it today." Li Luo quickly shook his head. "I'm about to get sick of singing those two songs. Let's change it up today."

"Then what do you want to sing?"

"Let's sing something new."

Li Luo picked up the guitar from the corner, sat on a chair, and looked at Yan Zhusheng with a smile. "See what you think of this song."

After saying that, Li Luo pondered for a moment, and his fingers began to play the guitar.

A gentle and tranquil melody slowly flowed from his fingertips.

As the rhythm gradually built, Li Luo began to sing softly: "If you are fireworks over the sea"

"I am the foam of a wave"

"For a moment, your light illuminated me"

Listening to the new song coming from Li Luo's mouth, Yan Zhusheng's eyes gradually brightened. With a gentle sway of her body, she slowly fell into the beautiful, dreamlike world woven by Li Luo.

In the evening, after having dinner with Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu, Yan Zhusheng obediently took her leave and went home.

Exhausted from the afternoon, Xu Youyu stretched, then walked dejectedly into the kitchen to wash dishes with Ying Chanxi.

After finishing, she went back to her room, flopped onto the bed, and went to catch up on sleep.

Ying Chanxi, on the other hand, took out the clothes she had put in the washing machine during dinner and brought them to the balcony to dry.

The next second, Ying Chanxi looked at Li Luo, who was resting on the living room sofa, with great surprise and asked, "Did the sun rise from the west? Since when do you wash your own bedsheets?"

"I had nothing to do this afternoon, so I just tidied up a bit," Li Luo said with a couple of coughs.

"I guess you've made some progress." Ying Chanxi huffed twice, then patted Li Luo on the shoulder. "I'm going to use your computer then, okay? Are you going back to your room?"

"Go ahead, you do your thing. I'll stay in the living room for a bit," Li Luo said, then stood up and went back to his bedroom first to take out the laptop Yan Zhusheng had lent him.

Ying Chanxi didn't notice and walked straight into Li Luo's room, where she began to seriously edit videos.

But Li Luo didn't return to the bedroom for a long time, which made her feel a little bored.

Around eight o'clock in the evening, after she finished processing the footage for a music video, Ying Chanxi stood up and walked out.

Then, she saw Li Luo.

And on the desk in front of Li Luo, a laptop computer.

"...Where did you get this laptop?" Ying Chanxi walked over, looking completely bewildered, and asked.

"Oh, this," Li Luo confessed honestly. "Yan Zhusheng lent it to me."

"Huh?" Ying Chanxi was stunned, her eyes silently staring at the laptop, speechless for a long time.

In the end, it was Pikachu who bore the brunt of it all.

(End of Chapter)
